description: Cut the sprites of an analysed screen out of its own concept image (buttons, panels, icons, background) with 9-slice margins, and write them next to the layout. Cutting is not an artistic approval: returns a required workflow gate. Assemble, capture the actual renderer, then call gripforge_hud workflow to run the reviewer. 0 credits for cutting.
